name: parsimony-ecoli
description: 3D structural model of an E. coli cell: reads a v2ecoli molecular state and packs it into an interactive 3D scene with pbg-parsimony (parsimony engine). Output (pack.json + ingredient sidecar) renders in the bundled 3D webapp.

top_n.description: How many of the most-abundant protein monomers to include (AlphaFold-modelled), beyond the curated assemblies.

scale.description: Abundance scale applied to copy numbers (1.0 = full abundance; lower = lighter/faster).

state_source.description: 'snapshot' (saved v2ecoli state, fast) or 'live' (run the baseline composite).
